docs.title: Causal Mechanisms in Adolescent Arterial Stiffness
docs.summary: Hardening of the blood vessels, called arterial stiffness, is a risk factor for future heart disease and its causes are unclear. The proposed study will 1) randomly assign adolescents at high risk of stiffening blood vessels to take a protein supplement called carnitine and study its effects on arterial stiffening and 2) study carnitine related genes for their effect on arterial stiffening. The study will definitively establish a role for carnitine action as a cause of stiffening blood vessels and signal a way to treat or prevent stiffening.

docs.title: Oxytocin for Respiratory Compromise and Hypoventilation Induced by Drugs
docs.summary: Drug overdose is a national crisis. The primary cause of death associated with opioids is opioid-induced respiratory depression. Naloxone (Narcan) which is the first line of defense for opioid overdose can reverse OIRD (Opioid-Induced Respiratory Depression), but in post-operative patients it will abolish pain control. There are no medications that can prevent OIRD. Pre-clinical studies provided evidence that intranasal (administered via a nasal spray) oxytocin may prevent and treat OIRD without interfering with pain control.

docs.summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to learn if treatment with ticagrelor tablets can decrease inflammation in patients with Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD). Inflammation is thought to contribute to the risk of heart disease which is the leading cause of death in patients with CKD. Decreasing inflammation may decrease the risk of heart disease.

The main questions it aims to answer are:

* Why are patients with CKD at increased risk for heart disease and how to reduce that risk in the future.
* If there could be new treatment options for managing inflammation in blood of patients with CKD.
